headline: Barkley banged up again - this time a hamstring
body: Saquon Barkley underwent tests Monday for a hamstring injury; early word is it "does not appear to be overly serious," but he's questionable for Week 5. His own handcuff, Tank Bigsby, is now out for weeks anyway (see below), so Will Shipley is the clear next man up if Barkley sits.

headline: Tank Bigsby headed to IR - needs core muscle surgery
body: A popular Week 2-3 handcuff/speculative add, Bigsby is now out at least 4 weeks after a core muscle injury required surgery. Anyone who stashed him as Eagles insurance needs a new plan.

headline: Jadarian Price's chest injury turned into an IR stint
body: What looked like a minor chest injury with negative X-rays back in Week 2 ended up costing Price his season for now - he's on IR, and Emanuel Wilson has taken the Seattle backfield over completely.

headline: Bengals WR room thinning out: Chase in protocol, Higgins ailing
body: Ja'Marr Chase is in the concussion protocol and Tee Higgins is dealing with an adductor issue, opening up real target share for Mike Gesicki and the rest of Cincinnati's offense this week.

headline: Chiefs WR corps gutted by injury
body: Rashee Rice (hamstring) could miss several weeks and Tyquan Thornton is out 12-16 weeks with a dislocated ankle - a tough stretch for Kansas City's passing game depth.

headline: Denver's backfield picture is wide open
body: With both J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey banged up, rookie Jonah Coleman flashed real three-down ability in relief. Some analysts think he simply keeps the job even once the other two are healthy.
